The first submission records the attempt, updates the best stars/attempt count of that context only (Adventure, or this one assignment turn) and adds points for the improvement only, all in one transaction. info.title: Hodhod student API
info.description: Implemented endpoints only. Email-code or password sign-in and revocable Bearer sessions.

message.example: If the account is eligible, a verification code will arrive shortly

code.description: Six-digit emailed code; 11111 only in explicitly enabled development mode
Six-digit emailed code; 11111 only in explicitly enabled development mode

hasPassword.description: Whether a password is set; choose password/set or password/change accordingly

avatarId.description: Avatar catalog identifier; letters, digits, underscore and hyphen. Null clears selection.

timezone.description: Named IANA timezone; numeric UTC offsets are not accepted

membership.description: Null is a valid student without a class

code.description: Case-sensitive class code; surrounding whitespace is trimmed

id.description: Stable backend content ID; progress and reports always refer to this

unityId.description: Unity identifier of the current published version; may change between versions

maxStars.description: Stars available under the effective scoring rule (content rule, else global, else default)

passStars.description: Best stars needed to pass under the effective scoring rule

contentId.description: Stable content ID of the stage

prerequisiteContentId.description: Stage that must be cleared first; null for an entry stage

unlockStars.description: Best stars needed on the prerequisite to unlock this stage

status.description: Computed by the server for the authenticated student

maxStars.description: Star ceiling of the applicable scoring rule (default 5)

passStars.description: Stars needed to pass this stage (default 3)

stages.description: Published Adventure stages in order, including locked ones

nextContentId.description: First unlocked stage not yet passed; null when nothing is left to play

assignmentId.description: Identifies this turn; the same game assigned again has a different ID

unityId.description: Unity ID of the current released version; null when the content is no longer published

available.description: The content is still published. An active turn is playable only when this is true.

phase.description: From the server clock: upcoming (not started), active (open now), ended (window over)

status.description: Your status in this turn only

points.description: Points you earned in this turn only

attemptId.description: Client-generated unique ID of this attempt; resending the same ID never creates a second attempt

assignmentId.description: Required for the assignment context (the turn being played); not allowed for adventure

stars.description: Stars earned; must not exceed the rule ceiling

durationSeconds.description: Play time in seconds. The server stamps receipt time itself and derives the start from this duration.

passed.description: This context has been passed at least once

improved.description: This attempt raised the best stars of the context

activityDate.description: Calendar date in your timezone at the time the server received the attempt

newDay.description: This attempt created the activity day (a day counts once; only a qualifying result creates it)

currentDays.description: Consecutive activity days ending today or yesterday; 0 when the run is over

bonusPoints.description: Points for the new day from STREAK_DAILY_POINTS; 0 when none is configured or the day already counted

duplicate.description: true when this is a replay of an already recorded attempt; the rest of the body is identical to the first response

passed.description: stars reached passStars in this attempt

pointsAwarded.description: Points this attempt added (only the improvement over the previous best in the same context)

streak.description: Activity day and streak after this attempt. Absent on results stored before streaks existed.

contentId.description: Stable content ID of a game you have played

rating.description: Interest rating, 1 to 4. Unrelated to stars and points.
null when you have not rated this game

currentDays.description: Consecutive activity days ending today or yesterday; 0 once a whole local day was missed

activeToday.description: An activity day already exists for today in your timezone

timezone.description: Timezone currently used to decide the day of new attempts

today.description: Today in your timezone, from the server clock

recentDays.description: Your last 30 activity days, newest first

points.description: Total points from the whole ledger (stars, streak, adjustments), independent of class changes

className.description: Your current class name for the class board

top.description: Best five, in order. Contains you when you are among them.

me.description: Your own position when you are not in top; null when you are already listed there
